title: AndroidLab: Training and Systematic Benchmarking of Android Autonomous Agents
authors_zh: Yifan Xu, Xiao Liu, Xueqiao Sun, Siyi Cheng, Hao Yu, Hanyu Lai, Shudan Zhang, Dan Zhang, Jie Tang, Yuxiao Dong
paper_type_zh: Android agent 环境、轨迹数据发布与系统评测
best_for_zh: 研究移动 GUI agent 轨迹构造、SFT、环境 verifier、可回放评测与发布审计的读者
one_line: AndroidLab releases a 726-trajectory Android SFT subset and a 138-task AVD benchmark with UI/device-state and LLM-judged terminal feedback, while splits, failed traces, data rights, and immutable replay remain unresolved.
AndroidLab 发布 726 条 Android SFT 轨迹及含混合终态反馈的 138 任务 AVD 基准，但数据划分、失败轨迹、数据权利与不可变回放条件仍未解决。
why: It exposes how a mobile agent's training record connects task, XML or screenshot state, action, history, and completion feedback; it also shows why app/version pinning, alternate-valid-path verification, failure retention, train/eval overlap, and dataset licensing determine whether such trajectories can be safely reused.
inclusion_reason: AndroidLab joins an Android environment, a released state-action SFT subset, executable task-specific subgoal predicates, query judgments, and a documented collection pipeline. It is a core environment/trajectory-data entry because it makes observation modality, action schema, reset behavior, terminal feedback, selected-trace supervision, and release risks jointly auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
AndroidLab's canonical source is the ACL 2025 camera-ready paper (ACL Anthology 2025.acl-long.107, pp. 2144–2166, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.107), supplemented by arXiv:2410.24024v2 and the official repository inspected at commit 4bfe108cf3883b710e8e5c6fba288161c830e504. The work addresses two coupled problems: collecting executable Android demonstrations for instruction tuning and evaluating autonomous agents against reproducible app states and explicit success conditions.

The training data object is a manually executed Android trace. Its public description combines a task/system instruction, interaction history, an XML observation or marked screenshot, analysis/reasoning, and one function-call action; annotation also captures a screenshot and page XML before each operation. The official SFT material is described in LlamaFactory format as 726 traces comprising 6,208 XML-mode steps and 6,053 SoM-mode steps. Exact archive fields, episode IDs, assets, provenance columns, and file hashes remain unverified because android-lab-train.zip was not inspected record by record.

The evaluation object is separate: one of 138 tasks across nine apps, a pre-packaged AVD state, an instruction, the agent framework/model, state-action-observation history, and task-specific completion output. The suite contains 93 operation tasks and 45 query tasks. Operation outputs are state sequences; query outputs additionally include a free-form answer.

This belongs to environment_agent_trajectory_data because Android state, actions, observations, resets, and terminal judgments jointly define both supervision and evaluation. It does not establish that the broader 10.5K traces / 94.3K steps generated during autonomous and manual collection were all released or used for SFT, and it must not be conflated with AndroidWorld, AndroidControl, or V-Droid. The official paper, code, evaluator, and artifact pointers support a complete bilingual Card, while corpus bytes, licensing, splits, failure retention, and immutable replay remain partial.

AndroidLab 的 canonical source 是 ACL 2025 camera-ready 论文（ACL Anthology 2025.acl-long.107，第 2144–2166 页，DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.107）；辅助核验来源为 arXiv:2410.24024v2，以及在 commit 4bfe108cf3883b710e8e5c6fba288161c830e504 检查的官方代码仓库。该工作同时处理两个相互关联的问题：为 instruction tuning 收集可执行的 Android demonstration，以及在可复现 app 状态和明确成功条件下评测 autonomous agent。

训练数据对象是一条由人工执行的 Android trace。公开描述显示，它由 task/system instruction、interaction history、XML observation 或带标记的 screenshot、analysis/reasoning 和一次 function-call action 构成；标注过程还会在每次操作前采集 screenshot 与 page XML。官方 SFT 材料以 LlamaFactory 格式描述，共 726 条 trace、6,208 个 XML-mode step 和 6,053 个 SoM-mode step。由于未对 android-lab-train.zip 做 record-level 检查，archive 的确切字段、episode ID、asset、provenance column 与 file hash 仍未核验。

评测对象与训练对象不同：它包含 138 个任务之一、一个预打包 AVD 状态、一条 instruction、agent framework/model、state-action-observation history 以及 task-specific completion output。该套件由 93 个 operation task 和 45 个 query task 组成，覆盖 9 个 app；operation 输出是 state sequence，query 输出还包含 free-form answer。

该论文属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为 Android state、action、observation、reset 和 terminal judgment 共同定义了 supervision 与 evaluation。它并未证明 autonomous 与 manual collection 期间产生的 10.5K 条 trace / 94.3K 个 step 全部发布或进入 SFT，也不能与 AndroidWorld、AndroidControl 或 V-Droid 混同。官方论文、代码、evaluator 与 artifact pointer 足以支撑完整双语 Card，但 corpus bytes、license、split、failure retention 和 immutable replay 仍只达到 partial 状态。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AndroidLab connects a selected Android demonstration subset to a benchmark whose terminal feedback is executable or judged, making the observation/action schema, collection filter, and success contract visible in one system.

Its training object is a human-produced state-action trace in two observation modes. XML mode exposes task, history, and compressed UI XML; SoM mode exposes task, history, and a screenshot with numbered selectable elements. Both target function-call actions over Tap, Type, Swipe, Long Press, Home, Back, Enter, Wait, and Finish. LLM/VLM self-exploration contributed to the wider collection process but its operation data was explicitly removed from instruction fine-tuning; only the resulting reward model was retained for the next annotation stage.

The feedback contract has three distinct layers. During collection, a second annotator and a trajectory-level completion reward model cross-verify human traces. For benchmark operation tasks, hand-coded predicates inspect page/UI-tree fields and sometimes ADB/device state; every required subgoal must hold for success. For query tasks, GPT-4o-2024-05-13 or GLM-4 judges whether the answer supplied through Finish semantically matches a standard answer, with helper logic allowing up to five retries. Finish or the 25-step cap ends generation, but neither by itself proves evaluator success.

AndroidWorld is a separate 116-task/20-app reward-bearing benchmark discussed as prior work; AndroidLab contributes its own 138-task/9-app AVD suite and instruction-tuning pipeline. AndroidControl is not established as AndroidLab lineage, and V-Droid is later work rather than an AndroidLab component. The closest directional distinction is therefore the joint treatment of training traces, resettable Android state, operation predicates, and query judgment—not ownership of all Android-agent data or evaluation methods.

AndroidLab 把筛选后的 Android demonstration subset 与具有可执行或 judge-based terminal feedback 的 benchmark 连接起来，使 observation/action schema、collection filter 和 success contract 可以在同一系统中审计。

它的训练对象是包含两种 observation mode 的人工 state-action trace。XML mode 提供 task、history 与压缩后的 UI XML；SoM mode 提供 task、history 与带编号可选元素的 screenshot。两种模式都监督针对 Tap、Type、Swipe、Long Press、Home、Back、Enter、Wait 和 Finish 的 function-call action。LLM/VLM self-exploration 参与了更大的采集流程，但其 operation data 被明确移出 instruction fine-tuning；只有由此训练出的 reward model 被保留到下一标注阶段。

feedback contract 分为三层。采集阶段由第二位 annotator 和 trajectory-level completion reward model 交叉核验人工 trace。benchmark 的 operation task 使用 hand-coded predicate 检查 page/UI-tree field，并在部分任务中检查 ADB/device state；所有所需 subgoal 成立才算成功。query task 则由 GPT-4o-2024-05-13 或 GLM-4 判断通过 Finish 提交的答案是否与 standard answer 语义一致，helper logic 最多允许 5 次 retry。Finish 或 25-step 上限会结束生成，但二者本身都不能证明 evaluator success。

AndroidWorld 是论文对比的独立 116-task/20-app、带 reward benchmark；AndroidLab 拥有自己的 138-task/9-app AVD suite 和 instruction-tuning pipeline。现有证据未把 AndroidControl 建立为 AndroidLab lineage，V-Droid 则是后续工作而非 AndroidLab 组件。因此最接近的方向性差异，是把 training trace、可 reset 的 Android state、operation predicate 与 query judgment 联合起来，而不是对所有 Android-agent 数据或评测方法的归属主张。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs begin with task seeds from cited academic datasets, including Android in the Wild and SNIPS, plus hand-written instructions. Undisclosed language models expand the seeds, and humans review realism, feasibility, and executability. Source proportions, expansion prompts, generator snapshots, deduplication, and accepted/rejected task counts are unknown.

The collection and selection pipeline is:

  1. Autonomous and manual processes generate 10.5K traces / 94.3K steps in total. This is the broad collection pool, not the SFT set.
  2. Human annotators check feasibility, learn the app, and execute tasks on physical Android phones using ADB/ADB Keyboard. The tool records screenshots, page XML, and click, swipe, or text-input operations into a trace log. Phone, Android, app, account, network, and reset versions are not pinned.
  3. About 500 manually labeled positive and negative trajectories train a completion classifier; a second annotator and this reward model cross-verify collected human traces. Model architecture, checkpoint, split, calibration, threshold, and adjudication details are unknown.
  4. Self-exploration operation data is removed from SFT. Feasibility review, privacy masking, cross-verification, and app membership select 726 human traces / 6,208 XML steps from the nine benchmark apps. Converting observations to SoM leaves 6,053 steps because special pages that cannot be converted are dropped.
  5. LlamaFactory or Swift fine-tunes Llama-3.1-8B, GLM-4-9B, Qwen2-7B, Llama-3.2-11B-Vision, Qwen2-VL-7B, and CogVLM2. The camera-ready reports batch 32, maximum sequence length 4,096, learning rate 1e-5, and five epochs; the official repository guide reports the same learning rate but three epochs. Exact reproduction must preserve this unresolved 3-versus-5-epoch conflict rather than choosing silently.

Formal evaluation starts inside the specified app, uses greedy decoding, allows at most 25 steps with a 3-second response interval, and runs every task in a fresh cloned AVD/emulator or new Docker container that is stopped or deleted afterward. Current official configs target Pixel 7 Pro / Android API 33; code fixes geolocation and date (with a Maps.me exception). Operation tasks use UI-tree/device predicates, while query tasks use GPT-4o-2024-05-13 or GLM-4 answer judgment.

Reproduction must pin the repository commit, SFT archive and hash, Docker/AVD image digest, Android/emulator/Android Studio versions, APK/app versions, base snapshot and reset state, time/location/account/network conditions, six model revisions, trainer configs, judge prompts/API snapshots, and random seeds. Train/validation/test splits, item/template decontamination, and trace-level overlap with the 138 benchmark tasks are unknown; app-level overlap is explicit.

输入首先来自论文引用的 academic dataset（包括 Android in the Wild 和 SNIPS）及人工编写 instruction。未披露的 language model 扩展 seed，人工再审核 realism、feasibility 与 executability。source proportion、expansion prompt、generator snapshot、deduplication 以及 accepted/rejected task count 均为 unknown。

采集和筛选 pipeline 如下：

  1. Autonomous 与 manual process 总共产生 10.5K 条 trace / 94.3K 个 step；这是 broad collection pool，而不是 SFT set。
  2. Human annotator 先检查 feasibility、熟悉 app，再借助 ADB/ADB Keyboard 在实体 Android phone 上执行任务。工具将 screenshot、page XML，以及 click、swipe 或 text-input operation 记录到 trace log。phone、Android、app、account、network 和 reset version 均未固定。
  3. 约 500 条人工标注的 positive/negative trajectory 用于训练 completion classifier；第二位 annotator 与该 reward model 对收集到的人工 trace 进行 cross-verification。model architecture、checkpoint、split、calibration、threshold 与 adjudication detail 未披露。
  4. Self-exploration operation data 被移出 SFT。经过 feasibility review、privacy masking、cross-verification 和 app membership 筛选后，从 benchmark 相同的 9 个 app 中选出 726 条人工 trace / 6,208 个 XML step；转为 SoM observation 后剩余 6,053 个 step，因为无法转换的特殊页面被删除。
  5. LlamaFactory 或 Swift 用于 fine-tune Llama-3.1-8B、GLM-4-9B、Qwen2-7B、Llama-3.2-11B-Vision、Qwen2-VL-7B 与 CogVLM2。camera-ready 报告 batch 32、maximum sequence length 4,096、learning rate 1e-5 和 5 个 epoch；官方仓库指南报告相同 learning rate，但为 3 个 epoch。精确复现必须保留这一 3-vs-5 epoch 冲突，不能静默任选其一。

正式评测从指定 app 内开始，使用 greedy decoding，最多允许 25 个 step，device response interval 为 3 秒；每个任务都在 fresh cloned AVD/emulator 或 new Docker container 中运行，结束后停止或删除实例。当前官方 config 指向 Pixel 7 Pro / Android API 33；代码固定 geolocation 与 date（Maps.me 例外）。operation task 使用 UI-tree/device predicate，query task 使用 GPT-4o-2024-05-13 或 GLM-4 的 answer judgment。

复现时必须固定 repository commit、SFT archive 及 hash、Docker/AVD image digest、Android/emulator/Android Studio version、APK/app version、base snapshot 与 reset state、time/location/account/network condition、6 个 model revision、trainer config、judge prompt/API snapshot 和 random seed。train/validation/test split、item/template decontamination 以及与 138 个 benchmark task 的 trace-level overlap 均为 unknown；app-level overlap 则是明确事实。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The benchmark contains 138 tasks over Bluecoins, Calendar, Cantook, Clock, Contacts, Maps.me, PiMusic, Settings, and Zoom: 93 operation tasks and 45 query tasks (Paper §3.2.1; Appendix A/Table 4). Formal runs begin inside the target app and use a 25-step cap, greedy decoding, and a 3-second device interval (Paper §5.1). These conditions narrow the claim to in-app task completion rather than general phone operation from launch.

Table 1 reports that instruction tuning raises average success rate from 4.59% to 21.50% for the three LLMs and from 1.93% to 13.28% for the three VLMs. Model-level SR changes are Llama-3.1-8B 2.17→23.91, Qwen2-7B 4.35→19.57, GLM-4-9B 7.25→21.01, CogVLM2 0.72→11.59, Llama-3.2-11B-Vision 1.45→10.14, and Qwen2-VL-7B 3.62→18.12 (Paper Table 1, p. 8). These are author-reported benchmark results, not independent evidence that every released trace is correct, licensed, non-overlapping, or reusable.

The authors report more than 98% completion-classification accuracy for the reward model trained on about 500 positive and negative trajectories (Appendix C.3). Because the model identity, evaluation split and size, class balance, calibration, false-positive/negative analysis, and checkpoint are undisclosed, this number supports the described collection filter but does not establish external verifier reliability.

Figure 5 shows lower SoM performance on Pixel 3a and Pixel Fold than on common-size Pixel 7/8 Pro screens, demonstrating that viewport and UI geometry materially affect results. The paper also reports hard-coded task evaluators, variable XML quality, Android-only coverage, and a fixed wait that may not suit all devices. No experiment was independently replayed for this Card, and the data and environment bundles were not hash-verified.

benchmark 覆盖 Bluecoins、Calendar、Cantook、Clock、Contacts、Maps.me、PiMusic、Settings 与 Zoom，共 138 个任务，其中 93 个 operation task、45 个 query task（论文 §3.2.1；Appendix A/Table 4）。正式运行从目标 app 内部开始，采用 25-step 上限、greedy decoding 和 3 秒 device interval（论文 §5.1）。因此结论范围是 in-app task completion，而不是从启动 app 开始的一般手机操作。

Table 1 报告，instruction tuning 使 3 个 LLM 的平均 success rate 从 4.59% 提升到 21.50%，使 3 个 VLM 从 1.93% 提升到 13.28%。各模型 SR 分别为 Llama-3.1-8B 2.17→23.91、Qwen2-7B 4.35→19.57、GLM-4-9B 7.25→21.01、CogVLM2 0.72→11.59、Llama-3.2-11B-Vision 1.45→10.14、Qwen2-VL-7B 3.62→18.12（论文 Table 1，第 8 页）。这些是作者报告的 benchmark result，并非对每条发布 trace 都正确、获得许可、无重叠或可复用的独立证据。

作者报告，使用约 500 条 positive/negative trajectory 训练的 reward model 具有超过 98% 的 completion-classification accuracy（Appendix C.3）。由于 model identity、evaluation split 与 size、class balance、calibration、false-positive/negative analysis 和 checkpoint 均未披露，该数字只能支持论文描述的 collection filter，不能证明 verifier 的外部可靠性。

Figure 5 显示，SoM 在 Pixel 3a 与 Pixel Fold 上的表现低于常见尺寸的 Pixel 7/8 Pro，说明 viewport 与 UI geometry 会实质影响结果。论文还报告 hard-coded task evaluator、XML quality 波动、Android-only 范围，以及固定 wait time 可能不适合所有 device。该 Card 未独立 replay 实验，data 与 environment bundle 也未完成 hash verification。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior Android-agent work already provided demonstrations, mobile task suites, UI representations, and programmatic rewards. AndroidLab does not introduce Android interaction, XML observations, SoM prompting, human demonstrations, completion classifiers, or LLM answer judges in isolation.

Its concrete change is system-level coupling. The paper packages a fixed-state Android operation environment, 138 operation/query tasks, heterogeneous task-specific completion checks, a two-mode trace schema, a human/reward-model cross-verification process, and a selected SFT subset. This lets readers trace how a task seed becomes a state-action target and how an evaluated episode becomes success or failure.

A second contribution is the explicit separation of operation and query feedback. Operation success derives from UI-tree and sometimes device-state predicates over subgoals; query success derives from a model judgment against a standard answer. This mixed contract exposes different false-positive, false-negative, drift, and reproducibility risks that a single aggregate SR would hide.

The scale itself is not the novelty claim: 10.5K traces / 94.3K steps describe the broad construction process, whereas training uses 726 traces / 6,208 XML steps and 6,053 SoM steps, with self-exploration actions excluded. For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is the linkage among observation modality, human trace selection, executable environment state, and terminal feedback. Reuse still requires archive hashes, split/overlap manifests, failure ledgers, dataset rights, and immutable environment versions.

此前的 Android-agent 工作已经提供 demonstration、mobile task suite、UI representation 和 programmatic reward。AndroidLab 并非分别首创 Android interaction、XML observation、SoM prompting、human demonstration、completion classifier 或 LLM answer judge。

它的具体变化是 system-level coupling：论文把 fixed-state Android operation environment、138 个 operation/query task、异构 task-specific completion check、双 observation mode 的 trace schema、human/reward-model cross-verification process，以及筛选后的 SFT subset 放在同一系统中。这让读者能够追踪 task seed 如何成为 state-action target，也能追踪 evaluated episode 如何被判为 success 或 failure。

第二个贡献是明确区分 operation 与 query feedback。operation success 来自针对 subgoal 的 UI-tree predicate，并在部分任务中包含 device-state predicate；query success 则来自 model 对 standard answer 的 judgment。这个 mixed contract 暴露出单一 aggregate SR 会掩盖的 false positive、false negative、drift 与 reproducibility risk。

规模本身不是 novelty claim：10.5K 条 trace / 94.3K 个 step 描述 broader construction process，而训练实际使用 726 条 trace / 6,208 个 XML step 与 6,053 个 SoM step，self-exploration action 被排除。对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向性信号在于 observation modality、human trace selection、executable environment state 与 terminal feedback 之间的连接。复用前仍需补齐 archive hash、split/overlap manifest、failure ledger、dataset right 与 immutable environment version。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The public SFT package is described but was not audited record by record. Exact files, field names, trace IDs, media/XML assets, duplicates, record provenance, Drive version, and archive hash are unknown; mutable Google Drive links do not provide immutable release identity.
  • The paper and repository disagree on five versus three training epochs. Exact model revisions, optimizer, scheduler, seeds, compute, checkpoint selection, and trainer commits/configs are undisclosed, blocking an exact six-model SFT reproduction.
  • No train/validation/test manifest or decontamination method is disclosed. All 726 SFT traces come from the same nine apps as the benchmark, so app-level overlap is certain; item-, instruction-, template-, state-, and task-level overlap remain unknown.
  • Failed-data visibility is incomplete. About 500 positive/negative reward-model trajectories exist and self-exploration operation traces were dropped from SFT, but release counts and records for failures, infeasible tasks, skipped or abandoned traces, privacy-filtered samples, rejected expansions, disagreements, and selection decisions are unknown.
  • Operation predicates are hand-coded and heterogeneous. XML omissions, localization, alternate valid states, dynamic content, app/version drift, or transient matching pages can cause false positives or false negatives. ROR counts screen change rather than semantic action correctness, and agent Finish is not evaluator success.
  • Query scoring depends on GPT-4o-2024-05-13 or GLM-4, judge prompts, retries, APIs, and model behavior that can drift. A semantically valid paraphrase may be rejected or an incorrect answer accepted; immutable judge inputs and adjudication logs are unavailable.
  • Fresh AVD/container reset improves isolation, but the release does not pin image or base-state hashes, complete APK/app versions, Android Studio/emulator versions, account/network state, or all setup inputs. Official macOS documentation warns that Android Studio updates may break setup, and screen-size results show geometry sensitivity.
  • The repository code is MIT, but the dataset license is unknown. That code license does not establish rights for source tasks, annotations, screenshots/XML, model outputs, apps/APKs, UI content, or preloaded records. Consent, redaction, retention, deletion, compensation, and redistribution details are incomplete.
  • The official repository contains a hard-coded credential-like default in evaluation code. This Card does not reproduce the value; reuse requires removal from code/history, rotation or revocation, and secret-free configuration examples.
  • AndroidWorld, AndroidControl, and V-Droid are separate data and evaluation objects. Importing their counts, images, rewards, splits, or verifier behavior would create unsupported lineage and invalidate an AndroidLab audit.

• 公开 SFT package 只有描述，尚未完成 record-level 审计。exact file、field name、trace ID、media/XML asset、duplicate、record provenance、Drive version 与 archive hash 均为 unknown；可变的 Google Drive link 不能提供 immutable release identity。
  • 论文和仓库对训练 epoch 的报告分别为 5 与 3。exact model revision、optimizer、scheduler、seed、compute、checkpoint selection 和 trainer commit/config 未披露，因此无法精确复现 6 个模型的 SFT。
  • 未披露 train/validation/test manifest 或 decontamination method。全部 726 条 SFT trace 来自 benchmark 相同的 9 个 app，故 app-level overlap 可以确认；item、instruction、template、state 与 task-level overlap 仍为 unknown。
  • 失败数据的可见性不完整。约 500 条 positive/negative reward-model trajectory 确实存在，self-exploration operation trace 也被移出 SFT，但 failure、infeasible task、skipped/abandoned trace、privacy-filtered sample、rejected expansion、disagreement 与 selection decision 的发布数量和 record 均为 unknown。
  • operation predicate 由人工编码且异构。XML 缺失、localization、alternate valid state、dynamic content、app/version drift 或 transient matching page 都可能造成 false positive 或 false negative。ROR 统计 screen change，而不是 semantic action correctness；agent Finish 也不等于 evaluator success。
  • query score 依赖 GPT-4o-2024-05-13 或 GLM-4，以及会发生 drift 的 judge prompt、retry、API 与 model behavior。语义正确的 paraphrase 可能被拒绝，错误答案也可能被接受；immutable judge input 与 adjudication log 不可用。
  • fresh AVD/container reset 改善了隔离性，但 release 未固定 image/base-state hash、完整 APK/app version、Android Studio/emulator version、account/network state 与全部 setup input。官方 macOS 文档警告 Android Studio 更新可能破坏 setup，screen-size 实验也表明存在 geometry sensitivity。
  • repository code 使用 MIT license，但 dataset license 为 unknown。该 code license 不构成 source task、annotation、screenshot/XML、model output、app/APK、UI content 或 preloaded record 的权利依据。consent、redaction、retention、deletion、compensation 与 redistribution detail 也不完整。
  • 官方仓库的 evaluation code 中存在 hard-coded credential-like default。该 Card 不复述其值；复用前应将其从 code/history 中移除并 rotation 或 revocation，同时提供 secret-free configuration example。
  • AndroidWorld、AndroidControl 与 V-Droid 是独立的数据和评测对象。导入它们的 count、image、reward、split 或 verifier behavior 会造成 unsupported lineage，并使 AndroidLab 审计失真。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, AndroidLab is a concrete blueprint for mapping an interactive mobile episode into auditable post-training fields: task source, XML or marked-screenshot observation, history, analysis/action target, environment state, completion judgment, and provenance. A reconstruction can use the dual observation modes to compare representation effects while holding the action vocabulary and benchmark tasks fixed.

The operation/query split is useful for verifier design. Builders can test UI-tree/device predicates for alternate valid states and XML drift, separately audit GPT-4o/GLM-4 semantic judging for paraphrases and false decisions, and log agent-selected Finish independently from evaluator completion. Fresh AVD/container reset, fixed time/location, 25-step budget, and direct in-app start form an evaluation baseline whose omitted image/APK hashes should become explicit checklist items.

For SFT, the defensible data recipe is human physical-device execution followed by second-annotator/reward-model cross-verification, privacy filtering, self-exploration exclusion, and XML-to-SoM conversion. The broader 10.5K-trace pool must not be represented as the SFT corpus. Training reuse is blocked pending dataset licensing, archive inspection/hashing, split and overlap disclosure, failure retention, and reconciliation of the 3-versus-5-epoch recipe.

Reuse class: suitable as a paper/code-backed evaluation and audit reference when the repository, environment, judge, and task configs are pinned; suitable as an SFT recipe reference, but not yet as unrestricted training data. The accepted training_use remains only sft and evaluation; the public evidence does not justify RLVR, preference optimization, reward-model reuse, or general agent-RL claims.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，AndroidLab 提供了把 interactive mobile episode 映射为可审计 post-training field 的具体蓝图：task source、XML 或 marked-screenshot observation、history、analysis/action target、environment state、completion judgment 与 provenance。重建者可以在保持 action vocabulary 与 benchmark task 不变的情况下，用两种 observation mode 比较 representation effect。

operation/query 拆分适合 verifier 设计研究。构建者可以分别测试 UI-tree/device predicate 对 alternate valid state 与 XML drift 的稳健性，审计 GPT-4o/GLM-4 semantic judgment 在 paraphrase 和错误判定上的表现，并把 agent-selected Finish 与 evaluator completion 分开记录。fresh AVD/container reset、固定 time/location、25-step budget 与直接从 app 内启动构成一个 evaluation baseline；其缺失的 image/APK hash 应成为明确的审计项。

对 SFT 而言，可辩护的数据 recipe 是 human physical-device execution，随后进行 second-annotator/reward-model cross-verification、privacy filtering、self-exploration exclusion 与 XML-to-SoM conversion。不得把更大的 10.5K-trace pool 表述成 SFT corpus。dataset license、archive inspection/hash、split 与 overlap disclosure、failure retention 以及 3-vs-5 epoch recipe 冲突解决之前，training reuse 仍被阻塞。

复用等级：当 repository、environment、judge 与 task config 被固定后，可作为论文/代码支撑的 evaluation 与 audit reference；也可作为 SFT recipe reference，但尚不能作为 unrestricted training data。accepted training_use 仅为 sft 和 evaluation；现有公开证据不支持 RLVR、preference optimization、reward-model reuse 或 general agent-RL claim。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Paper §§4.1–4.3 and Appendix C together: 10.5K traces / 94.3K steps describe total collection, whereas SFT uses 726 traces / 6,208 XML steps and 6,053 SoM steps.
  • Self-exploration operation data is excluded from SFT; only its learned completion reward model is carried into the next annotation stage.
  • Inspect evaluation/task.py, task implementations, and generate_result.py before interpreting SR: operation tasks use UI/device predicates, query tasks use GPT-4o or GLM-4 judgment, and Finish is not success.
  • Treat fresh AVD/container reset and Pixel 7 Pro / API 33 configs as replay ingredients, not immutable reproduction: image, APK/app, emulator, and base-state hashes are missing.
  • Resolve the paper's five epochs versus the repository guide's three epochs, and obtain splits, overlap/decontamination, failure ledgers, archive hashes, and data rights before training reuse.
  • Read AndroidWorld, AndroidControl, and V-Droid only as separate comparisons; none supplies missing AndroidLab lineage or release facts.

• 先合并阅读论文 §§4.1–4.3 与 Appendix C：10.5K 条 trace / 94.3K 个 step 是总采集规模，而 SFT 使用 726 条 trace / 6,208 个 XML step 与 6,053 个 SoM step。
  • Self-exploration operation data 没有进入 SFT；只有由其训练出的 completion reward model 被带入下一标注阶段。
  • 解读 SR 前应检查 evaluation/task.py、task implementation 与 generate_result.py：operation task 使用 UI/device predicate，query task 使用 GPT-4o 或 GLM-4 judgment，Finish 不等于 success。
  • fresh AVD/container reset 和 Pixel 7 Pro / API 33 config 是 replay ingredient，不是 immutable reproduction；image、APK/app、emulator 与 base-state hash 仍缺失。
  • training reuse 前应解决论文 5 个 epoch 与仓库指南 3 个 epoch 的冲突，并取得 split、overlap/decontamination、failure ledger、archive hash 与 data right。
  • AndroidWorld、AndroidControl 与 V-Droid 只能作为独立 comparison 阅读；它们都不能补充 AndroidLab 缺失的 lineage 或 release fact。

value.html: A released Android state-action SFT subset paired with a live AVD benchmark: the training object is derived from manually executed traces, while the evaluation object is a task plus replayable initial phone state, interaction history, observations, actions, and a task-specific terminal judgment.

Academic datasets (the paper cites Android in the Wild and SNIPS) and manually written instructions seed task generation; undisclosed language models expand the seeds and humans review feasibility, realism, and executability. Source proportions, exact prompts, model snapshots, and record-level source tags are unknown.

XML mode exposes current compressed Android UI XML plus task and history. SoM mode exposes a screenshot with numbered selectable elements plus task and history. Annotation captures screenshots and XML before each action; special pages that could not be converted to SoM account for 155 fewer SoM than XML steps.

The official release is described as LlamaFactory-format data with 6,208 XML-mode steps and 6,053 SoM-mode steps. Paper prompts show a task/system instruction followed by repeated XML or marked-screenshot observations and assistant analysis plus one function-call action. The archive could not be record-level inspected, so exact field names, image packing, episode IDs, and provenance columns are unknown.

Human annotators execute tasks on Android phones and record each step. A reward model and second annotator cross-verify traces. LLM/VLM self-exploration produced candidate traces but its operation data was explicitly removed from instruction fine-tuning.

AndroidLab uses pre-packaged Android Virtual Device state with fixed screen size, Android/API version, apps, and usage history. The current official configs target Pixel 7 Pro / Android API 33 and support a macOS arm64 AVD or Linux x86_64 Docker path. Human data collection instead uses annotators' physical Android phones, whose versions are not pinned.

Mixed contract. Operation tasks use hand-coded UI-tree and, for some tasks, device/ADB-state predicates for subgoals and completion. Query tasks compare a Finish answer with a standard answer using GPT-4o-2024-05-13 or GLM-4. Data collection uses a second annotator and a trajectory-level reward model trained on about 500 positive and negative traces; the paper reports over 98% completion-classification accuracy but releases neither its checkpoint nor test protocol.

Agent-selected Finish or the 25-step cap stops generation, but benchmark success is separate: all operation subgoal predicates must be true, or an LLM judge must accept the query answer. Post-hoc code retains the last state whose judge_page is true. For SFT traces, successful completion is human/reward-model cross-verified, but serialized terminal labels in the public archive are unverified.

Academic/manual seed -> LM task expansion -> human feasibility review -> physical-phone execution with screenshot/XML capture -> reward-model and second-annotator cross-verification -> select 726 traces/6,208 XML steps from the nine benchmark apps -> derive 6,053 SoM steps -> LlamaFactory/Swift SFT. Record-level source, reviewer, rejection, and archive-version provenance are unknown.

Fine-tuned families are Llama-3.1-8B, GLM-4-9B, Qwen2-7B, Llama-3.2-11B-Vision, Qwen2-VL-7B, and CogVLM2 (cogvlm2-llama3-chat-19B). The paper uses base variants where available except Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct; exact checkpoint revisions are unknown.

Human annotators provide executed target actions. Undisclosed LLMs expand instructions; LLM/VLM explorers and a learned reward model assist collection, but self-exploration actions are excluded from the SFT set. No single model teacher supplies the released action targets.

Human Android execution recorded through an ADB/accessibility annotation tool, after mixed manual and LM-assisted task generation. The benchmark runner separately generates evaluation episodes from a tested model interacting with a fresh AVD/container.

Hand-written instructions plus academic datasets with asserted available licenses, including Android in the Wild and SNIPS; exact dataset versions, task IDs, source weights, LM-expansion prompts, and accepted/rejected counts are unknown.

Autonomous and manual processes produced 10.5K traces and 94.3K steps. Only 726 traces and 6,208 XML steps from apps included in the AndroidLab benchmark were used for training; 6,053 SoM steps remain after conversion. The selection rule beyond app membership and cross-verification is undisclosed.
10.5K total collection traces are reported, but counts by task, app, generator, success/failure, retry, annotator, and selection stage are unknown. The public SFT subset contains 726 traces.
unknown

Task expansion, LLM/VLM self-exploration, human execution, cross-verification, XML/SoM conversion, LlamaFactory or Swift SFT, and an AndroidLab runner that starts each formal evaluation inside the specified app.
unknown

Humans reject infeasible tasks, may skip sensitive tasks/screens/apps, and cross-verify executed traces with a reward model and second annotator. Self-exploration operation data is removed from SFT, sensitive content is masked or withheld, and special pages that fail SoM conversion are dropped. Thresholds, disagreement resolution, and rejected counts are unknown.

Evaluation uses greedy decoding, at most 25 steps per task, a 3-second device response interval, and model-specific maximum generation settings such as 512 tokens in example configs. Data-generation decoding, retry, and token budgets are unknown.

Camera-ready paper reports batch size 32, maximum sequence length 4,096, learning rate 1e-5, and five epochs. Repository documentation reports LlamaFactory for four model families, Swift for CogVLM/Llama-3.2-Vision, learning rate 1e-5, and three epochs. This official-source 3-versus-5-epoch conflict blocks exact reproduction; optimizer, scheduler, seeds, hardware allocation, and checkpoint selection are unknown.

Manual and academic task seeds expanded by undisclosed LMs, then physical-phone human demonstrations across apps that include the same nine apps as the benchmark. Exact source/app/language/persona proportions and record-level lineage are unknown.
unknown

The paper explicitly selects all 726 SFT traces from apps included in AndroidLab. App-level train/evaluation overlap is therefore certain; no item-, instruction-, template-, or state-level overlap audit or held-out split is disclosed.
unknown

About 500 positive and negative trajectories train the completion reward model, while self-exploration operation data is removed and cross-verified human traces feed SFT. Public release of reward-model examples, failed/infeasible/skipped tasks, abandoned traces, privacy-filtered records, rejected expansions, and selection logs is unknown.

Formal runs create a fresh cloned AVD or Docker container per task, fix geolocation, set date except for Maps.me, launch directly into the specified app, and stop/delete the instance after the episode. Replay remains partial because image digests, complete APK/app versions, Android Studio/emulator versions, base-state hashes, random seeds, and evaluator API snapshots are not pinned; macOS docs warn that recent Android Studio updates may break setup.

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: Hand-coded UI-tree predicates are brittle to XML omissions, app/version drift, localization, alternate valid states, and dynamic UI content.
Query success depends on GPT-4o-2024-05-13 or GLM-4 wording judgment and an unversioned prompt/API path, allowing false positives, false negatives, and future drift.
Agent Finish and task success are distinct; a model can stop without satisfying the evaluator, while a post-hoc last matching page can score an earlier transient state.
ROR treats screen change as reasonableness, so semantically harmful or irrelevant actions can be counted as reasonable.
The reward model's reported >98% accuracy lacks a disclosed split, class balance, calibration, error analysis, or public checkpoint.
Starting every formal task inside the target app removes app-launch difficulty and narrows end-to-end comparability.
Screen-size experiments show geometry sensitivity, so results cannot be transferred across devices without controlling viewport and UI layout.
Fixed 3-second waits can be too short or wasteful across devices, and the paper identifies this as a limitation.
Only a selected human-trace subset is visible; absent failures and rejected examples prevent audit of selection bias and recovery behavior.
The official paper and training guide conflict on five versus three epochs.
The Google Drive data and environment bundles are mutable and lack verified hashes/tags; macOS setup is already documented as unstable after Android Studio updates.

value.html: Authors report advance notice of fine-tuning/open-release use, opt-out and task/screen/app skipping, local-first storage, review before upload, masking/replacement of usernames and chat logs, formal contracts, and compensation. Consent text, compensation amounts, redaction logs, retention/deletion rules, app-content rights, and independent privacy audit are not released.

Official code is MIT. Dataset license is unknown: the Google Drive archive has no verified data card or dataset- specific terms, and the code license does not establish rights for academic source tasks, annotations, screenshots/XML, model outputs, third-party apps/APKs, UI content, or preloaded records. ACL paper is CC BY 4.0.

Seed task -> LM expansion -> human feasibility check -> physical-phone state-action trace -> reward-model and second- annotator review -> nine-app 726-trace subset -> XML/SoM SFT examples -> six fine-tuned models -> AndroidLab evaluation. Self-exploration candidates, failures, rejected tasks, and reviewer decisions lack record-level public lineage.

Canonical publication is ACL 2025 camera-ready. arXiv stops at v2 (2024-11-04) and contains wording/count presentation that should not override the camera-ready. Official GitHub main was checked at 4bfe108cf3883b710e8e5c6fba288161c830e504 (2025-08-18), with no tag/release. Google Drive data/AVD/Docker artifacts have no verified version, checksum, or common manifest.
